tasks.short: Counsel clients in individual or group sessions.

steps.what: Read the posted referral on substance abuse or illness.
Counsel clients in individual or group sessions.

tasks.design: The social worker still counsels the client in the individual or group session. A referral line is already posted in the {DOCS}, with client, reason, date and the referrer's name, so the hunt for the paper referral is shorter. Nothing sends a record, raises an alert, or fills a sheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: The referral sat on paper in the file, so the social worker hunted it before the session.
tasks.enabler_now: The case file already holds a referral line. Showing client, reason, date and the referrer's name is configuration of that file.
tasks.still_hard: The session is the work. Poverty, unemployment, illness and abuse come out in the client's own words, not in the referral line.
tasks.human_edge: The social worker hears what the client will not put on a line, and answers in the room.
tasks.altitude: The week is still the session. Less time goes to hunting a referral. The social worker still counsels.

reach.task: Attend the individual or group session.
reach.learn: The session is not a form. The social worker still counsels.

reach.task: Post the referral line before the session.
reach.learn: The line needs client, reason, date and the referrer's name, or the social worker reads the paper.

reach.task: Sit in a group session when the plan says so.
reach.learn: The counselor does not replace the social worker's counsel.

evidence.claim: Counselling stays with the social worker. A posted referral can be read before the session. The session itself is not shorter. Model knowledge.
Recording a staff conversation needs works-council consent. This design does not record the session.
Health data are a special category. The referral line is already in the case file. This design adds no new store of the session.
A decision about a person may not rest solely on automated processing. This design decides nothing about the client.
Drafted care notes have contained invented statements, including suicidal ideation. This design does not draft the session.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: this task is the social worker's own counsel in an individual or group session. Intake, the treatment plan and the progress note sit outside it. The physician posts the referral before the session.

Structured input: one referral line in the {DOCS} with client, reason, date and the referrer's name. If the line is missing or free text, the social worker reads the paper referral and that read is not shorter.

The session stays with the social worker. Nothing sends a record, raises an alert, or fills a sheet. There is no commit, so there is no gate on a sent version. The prior that this is an outside act is refused: counselling is a talk in the room, not a send outside the organisation.
A model is not used. The session is judgement in the room. Existing system runtime is not the social worker's time.
unknowns: Whether this service's referral already has client, reason, date and a referrer's name, or only paper.
Whether group sessions include a counselor in the room, or the social worker alone.
research_questions: Who posts the referral, the physician or an intake worker?
What share of sessions start with no line the social worker can read?

already_counted.description: Reading a missing or free-text referral by hand, inside the remaining read.

incremental.description: Checking that the referral still has client, reason, date and a referrer's name.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the referral is often missing or free text, so the social worker still hunts the paper and the read is not shorter. High: most lines carry client, reason, date and a name, and only that hunt shrinks. The session stays. The high stays under the net after the field check.

tasks.short: Collaborate with counselors, physicians or nurses to plan treatment.

steps.what: Read the posted treatment note for this patient.
Collaborate with counselors, physicians or nurses to plan treatment.

tasks.design: The social worker still sits with the counselor, the physician or the nurse and plans treatment from the patient's need. A treatment note is already posted in the {DOCS}, with patient, treatment line, date and the author's name, so the hunt for that note is shorter. Nothing sends a record, raises an alert, or fills a sheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: The treatment note sat in someone else's paper file, so the social worker hunted it before the planning talk.
tasks.enabler_now: The case file already holds a treatment note. Showing patient, treatment line, date and the author's name is configuration.
tasks.still_hard: The plan is made in the talk. The patient's need does not sit in the note.
tasks.human_edge: The social worker brings the social-work view. A posted line cannot coordinate the people in the room.
tasks.altitude: The week is still the planning talk. Less time goes to hunting a treatment note. The social worker still plans with the counselor, the physician or the nurse.

reach.task: Post the treatment note and join the planning talk.
reach.learn: The note needs patient, treatment line, date and the author's name. The talk is not a message.

reach.task: Bring the patient's current need to the planning talk.
reach.learn: The social worker still plans from that need, not from a generated plan.

reach.task: Plan treatment in the room with the social worker.
reach.learn: Nothing is sent outside the organisation.

evidence.claim: Planning treatment with a counselor, a physician or a nurse stays a talk. A posted treatment note can be read first. The talk is not shorter. Model knowledge.
Recording a staff conversation needs works-council consent. This design does not record the planning talk.
Health data are a special category. The treatment note is already in the case file. This design adds no new store.
Profiling of a person is high-risk. This design does not profile the patient and does not draft the plan.
Drafted care notes have contained invented statements, including suicidal ideation. This design does not draft the treatment plan.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: this task is the social worker's planning talk with a counselor, a physician or a nurse. The session, the progress note and the referral sit outside it. The physician posts the treatment note before the talk.

Structured input: one treatment note in the {DOCS} with patient, treatment line, date and the author's name. If the line is missing or free text, the social worker reads the paper note and that read is not shorter.

The talk stays in the organisation. Counselors, physicians and nurses are colleagues for this step. Nothing sends a record, raises an alert, or fills a sheet. There is no commit. The prior that this is an outside act is refused: planning treatment together is a talk, not a send.
A model is not used. Existing system runtime is not the social worker's time.
unknowns: Whether the treatment note is posted by the physician before the talk, or only written during it.
Whether the planning talk is in one room or split across a ward and an office.
research_questions: Which of the counselor, the physician and the nurse is in the room for a typical plan?
What share of talks start with no treatment note the social worker can read?

tasks.short: Monitor, evaluate and record client progress on treatment goals.

steps.what: Read the posted treatment goal for this client.
Monitor and evaluate client progress in the session.
Record client progress against the treatment goal.

tasks.design: The social worker still monitors the client, still evaluates progress against the treatment goal, and still writes the progress note. A goal line is already posted in the {DOCS}, with client, goal, date and the author's name, so the hunt for the paper goal is shorter. Nothing sends a record, raises an alert, or fills a sheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: The treatment goal sat on the paper plan, so the social worker hunted it before judging progress.
tasks.enabler_now: The case file already holds a goal line. Showing client, goal, date and the author's name is configuration. The note is still written by the social worker.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the client moved is a judgement in the session. The note has to say what was seen, not what a draft invented.
tasks.human_edge: The social worker sees the client against the goal and writes only what happened.
tasks.altitude: The week is still the session and the note. Less time goes to hunting the goal. The social worker still monitors, evaluates and records.

reach.task: Attend so progress can be seen.
reach.learn: The social worker still watches and still writes the note.

reach.task: Post the treatment goal before this review.
reach.learn: The line needs client, goal, date and the author's name, or the social worker reads the paper plan.

reach.task: Read the progress note in the case file.
reach.learn: The note is not sent as a message. The physician reads what the social worker wrote.

evidence.claim: The social worker monitors and evaluates progress in the session and writes the progress note. A posted goal can be read first. The session and the note are not shorter. Model knowledge.
Recording a staff conversation needs works-council consent. This design does not record the session. The social worker writes the note.
A GGZ dossier is kept for twenty years. The progress note stays in that existing dossier. This design adds no second store.
Drafted care notes have contained invented statements, including suicidal ideation. This design does not draft the progress note.
A probation risk formula put about 21% of cases in another category, mostly too low. This review does not score risk.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: this task is the social worker's monitoring, evaluation and progress note against a treatment goal. The planning talk that set the goal sits outside it. The counselor posts the goal before this review.
Structured input: one goal line in the {DOCS} with client, goal, date and the author's name. If the line is missing or free text, the social worker reads the paper plan and that read is not shorter.

The social worker still writes the progress note into the existing dossier. Nothing sends a record, raises an alert, or fills a sheet. There is no commit of a generated note, so there is no gate on a sent version. Reach is internal: the note is not sent outside the organisation.
A model is not used, because drafted notes have contained statements the session did not. Existing system runtime is not the social worker's time.
unknowns: Whether the goal line already has client, goal, date and an author's name.
Whether the progress note is written the same day or later in the week.
research_questions: Who posts the goal, the counselor or the social worker at the planning talk?
What share of reviews start with no goal line the social worker can read?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the goal is often missing or free text, so the hunt stays and the read is not shorter. High: most goals carry client, goal, date and a name, and only that hunt shrinks. Monitoring, evaluation and the handwritten note stay. The high stays under the net after the field check.

tasks.short: Interview clients, review records and confer to evaluate condition.

steps.what: Review the posted record of the client's condition.
Interview clients and conduct the mental or physical assessment.
Confer with other professionals on that condition.

tasks.design: The social worker still interviews the client, still assesses the mental or physical condition, and still confers with other professionals in the room. A record line is already posted in the {DOCS}, with client, date, condition line and the author's name, so the hunt for the old record is shorter. Nothing sends a record, raises an alert, or fills a sheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: The last record sat in a paper file, so the social worker hunted it before the interview.
tasks.enabler_now: The case file already holds that record line. Showing client, date, condition line and the author's name is configuration.
tasks.still_hard: The condition is judged in the interview. A conferral with another professional is a talk, and it does not become a score.
tasks.human_edge: The social worker hears the client and weighs the condition. A posted line cannot do that interview.
tasks.altitude: The week is still the interview and the conferral. Less time goes to hunting an old record. The social worker still evaluates the condition.

reach.learn: The assessment is the social worker's judgement in the room.

reach.task: Post the last condition line and confer when asked.
reach.learn: The line needs client, date, condition line and the author's name. The conferral is a talk, not a send.

reach.task: Confer on the condition in the room.

evidence.claim: The interview, the assessment and the conferral stay with the social worker. A posted record can be read first. Those talks are not shorter. Model knowledge.
Recording a staff conversation needs works-council consent. This design does not record the interview or the conferral.
A decision about a person may not rest solely on automated processing. This design does not assess the client by itself.
Eligibility for public assistance and reoffending risk are high-risk uses. This assessment decides neither.
A probation risk formula put about 21% of cases in another category, mostly too low. This assessment does not score risk.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: this task is the social worker's interview, assessment and conferral on the client's condition. Treatment planning and the progress note sit outside it. The physician posts the last condition line before the interview.

Structured input: one record line in the {DOCS} with client, date, condition line and the author's name. If the line is missing or free text, the social worker reads the paper record and that read is not shorter.

The interview and the conferral stay in the room. Other professionals are colleagues. Nothing sends a record, raises an alert, or fills a sheet. There is no commit. The prior that this is an outside act is refused: interviewing a client and conferring with a colleague are talks, not sends.
A model is not used, and no risk score is produced. Existing system runtime is not the social worker's time.
unknowns: Whether the last condition line already has client, date, a condition line and an author's name.
Whether the conferral is the same day as the interview or a later meeting.
research_questions: Who posts the condition line, the physician or the social worker's own earlier note?
What share of interviews start with no record the social worker can read?
